ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a marine food chain: a plankton area labeled “plankton 1.7 ppb” in the lower right, with arrows from the plankton location pointing to fish and squid, indicating that fish and squid feed on plankton. The figure also shows that fish and squid are further used by animals such as seabirds and dolphins. According to food chain rules, if a food source completely disappears, the organisms that depend on it will lack food, so their numbers will decrease. Since fish and squid directly depend on plankton, when there is no plankton, the populations of fish and squid will decrease.
